verdict.rationale: Better Stack's own marketing says you can acknowledge many simultaneous incidents "with a single tap" to stop your phone ringing, and it documents push notifications and acknowledging a voice-call alert by pressing 1. That shows phone-based acknowledgement, but no dedicated mobile app is explicitly named, and escalating or resolving from the phone is not evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a full mobile app, resolve and escalate actions from mobile, mobile incident detail views, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, a full mobile app lets me acknowledge, escalate, and resolve from my phone at 3am

citations.quote: Acknowledge them with a single tap and stop your phone from ringing.
Acknowledge them with a single tap and keep your phone from ringing while fixing the issue.
As well as SMS, e-mail, Slack, Teams, and push notifications
When Uptime calls you, you are prompted to press 1 to acknowledge the incident.
